# Kai Siren

> Kai Siren is a platform engineer building governed agent systems, developer infrastructure, and the platform layer underneath.

Use the pages below as the canonical public profile. Other routes are retained only for archival compatibility and should not be treated as current.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.coilysiren.me/): Current platform thesis and active portfolio.
- [About](https://www.coilysiren.me/about/): Biography, visual autobiography, and collected interests.
- [Hiring](https://www.coilysiren.me/hiring/): Role fit, practical constraints, and interview boundaries.
- [Resume](https://www.coilysiren.me/resume/): Canonical experience and impact record.

## Projects

- [umbra](https://www.coilysiren.me/projects/umbra/): A config driven occlusion framework. Declares what an agent may execute, validates argv before execve, and records every call.

## Writing

The [writing index](https://www.coilysiren.me/writing/) lists the promoted posts. Three are promoted. The rest of the archive is retained at its URLs but is not current.

- [Stochastic Design Iteration](https://www.coilysiren.me/posts/stochastic-design-iteration/): A pattern for co-authoring a markdown design doc with an LLM.
- [On Permissions Models for Cloud Platform Providers](https://www.coilysiren.me/posts/on-permissions-models-for-cloud-platform-providers/): How Kai would build permissions for a cloud platform provider.
- [Deploying Azure OpenAI via Terraform](https://www.coilysiren.me/posts/azure-openai-terraform/): An end to end description of getting Azure OpenAI deployed via Terraform.
